approved_translation: A true estimate of values matters more than quantity; wisdom is in knowing what is enough.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: At one time a dishonest king had a man called the Valuer in his court. The Valuer set the price which ought to be paid for horses and elephants and the other animals. We used to think this great city was beyond price, but this man says it is worth only a measure of rice." Then the king was ashamed, and drove out the foolish fellow. "I tried to please the king by setting a low price on the horses, and now see what has happened to me!" said the Valuer, as he ran away from the laughing crowd.
